summary: The checkout layout demonstrates consistent styling and clear hierarchy, with minor typography spacing and vertical gap discrepancies.

issues.title: Header Kerning Artifacts
issues.description: Unintended letter spacing creates visible gaps within header text words.
issues.evidence: Text displays as 'Delivera ble' and 'assistan t' in card header labels.
issues.suggestion: Normalize font tracking and kerning across card header typography styles.

issues.title: Inconsistent Row Gutter Spacing
issues.description: Top-row cards have unequal heights, creating mismatched vertical spacing before the second row.
issues.evidence: The gap above the payment card is visibly narrower than the gap above the assistant card.
issues.suggestion: Equalize card heights across columns or use consistent row gap constraints.
